summary: Keep OpenSpec release intent, SemVer, native manifests, and consumer-facing changelog text aligned.

outcomes: Derive release impact and consumer-facing notes from accepted OpenSpec release artifacts.
Verify one version across release manifests and native package metadata.

scenarios.title: Prepare a product release
scenarios.prompt: Use $maintain-release-story to prepare the next release from completed OpenSpec changes without publishing it.
scenarios.outcome: A verified release set aligns SemVer, manifests, components, and consumer-facing changelog entries.

scenarios.title: Audit release consistency
scenarios.prompt: Use $maintain-release-story to check whether package versions and release notes match the accepted product changes.
scenarios.outcome: Version or release-story drift is reported with its authoritative source and exact repair boundary.
